title: Sage spread record
description: A spread record (SpreadRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another spread record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

baseDegrees.description: The cone at rest, standing still: a shot may stray this far from the aim. Unit: deg. At least 0. (float, default 0.5)

growthPerShot.description: How much wider the cone gets with every shot. Unit: deg. At least 0. (float, default 0.8)

maxDegrees.description: The widest the cone grows to before the movement multipliers. Unit: deg. At least 0. (float, default 6)

recoveryPerSecond.description: How fast the growth shrinks back while not firing. Unit: deg/s. At least 0. (float, default 6)

movingMultiplier.description: The cone is multiplied by this while moving. At least 0. (float, default 1.5)

crouchingMultiplier.description: The cone is multiplied by this while crouching. At least 0. (float, default 0.6)
